pain_point: Want to own not rent for retirement - I want to own the property so when I retire I can lease it out as passive income
headline_pain: Will Your Business Fund Your Exit?
headline_outcome: Retire With Passive Income Built In
primary_text: "When I retire I can lease it out as passive income." This is the exit strategy most small business owners overlook. You sell the business — but keep the property. Your former premises become a leased asset that pays you every month without lifting a finger. It's how thousands of Australian tradies, wholesalers, and operators have funded their retirements. These off-the-plan Truganina warehouses are perfectly positioned for this strategy: high-demand industrial location, near the Princes Freeway, and built to attract quality commercial tenants. Start now. Operate from it. Pay it down. Retire on it. Request the investment projections.
description: Sell the business, keep the property — passive income without the work
